definitions.explanation: Dark, shadowed skin under the eyes, typically from lack of sleep or fatigue. Often written クマ.

examples.english: I've got dark circles under my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{隈|くま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: My dark circles are terrible from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{徹夜|てつや}→徹夜：03552_tetsuya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{隈|くま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}く→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦コンシーラー→コンシーラー：23361_konshiiraa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{隠|かく}し→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧きれない。
examples.english: After night after night without sleep, my dark circles have got so dark that even concealer can't hide them.

notes:
Usually written in katakana, クマ, because the kanji is rare; the homophone ⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧ means bear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隈|くま}: dark circles under the eyes
- {隈|くま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to get dark circles
- {隈|くま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: to hide dark circles

RELATED WORDS:
- {隈|くま}なく: thoroughly, in every corner ({隈|くま} once meant a dark nook)
- ⟦{隈取|くまど}り→隈取り：16303_kumadori⟧: kabuki makeup lines
